Inside a try-with-resources, it creates a set of keys from rulesFacet, removes keys already present in alreadyLoadedRules, then uses Stream.concat to combine alreadyLoadedRules with the result of dbClient.ruleDao().selectDefinitionByIds after parsing the keys as integers via Integer::parseInt (potential NumberFormatException if any key is not a valid integer). It collects into a map from id to RuleKey. Then it iterates over rulesFacet entries, parsing each key via Integer.parseInt(k) (another potential NumberFormatException), looks up the id in the map, and either puts the key into a new map or logs an error. Finally, it clears and replaces rulesFacet. Runtime exceptions that can occur: ClassCastException at the cast, NumberFormatException at both parseInt calls. No current exception handling exists, so optimization is needed.
